title: Best Black Friday Gaming laptop deals live
summary: The best Black Friday gaming laptops still live this weekend.
content: While Black Friday might have technically ended, there is still a myriad of great savings on gaming laptops of every shape, size, and budget to be found. With AI driving up the cost of PC gaming every week, buying a gaming laptop is a great way to secure portable gaming power while dodging the very worst of the price hikes. Whether you're looking for a do-it-all beast with RTX 5090, or something light and portable for a quick blast on Fortnite every now and then, there's something for everyone at Amazon, Best Buy, Newegg, and beyond. We're also tracking great deals at vendors like HP, Dell, and Lenovo. We use our hands-on review and testing experience, as well as our extensive benchmark database, to bring you recommendations, as well as price tracking to make sure that discounts and deals are actually real. Here are all the best deals still live. Best Black Friday Gaming Laptop Deals: Quick Links Amazon: All Gaming Laptop Deals, up to $1,000 off Amazon: Up to 29% off MSI Gaming Laptops Our full list of Black Friday Gaming Laptops Deals Hottest Black Friday Gaming Laptop Deals The Asus ROG Strix G16 comes with a 16-inch screen, with an 1900 x 1200 pixel resolution, a 16:10 aspect ratio, and refresh and response rates of 165Hz and 3ms, respectively. Hardware inside this gaming laptop includes Nvidia's GeForce RTX 5070 Ti laptop GPU, an AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX processor, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB SSD for storage. View Deal The Alienware 16 Aurora is a gaming laptop casual gamers should definitely consider. It has a 10-core Core 7 240H CPU and a GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU, plus 16GB of DDR5 memory and a 512GB PCIe 4.0 SSD. View Deal Crosshair 16 (RTX 5060): was $2099 now $1399 The MSI Crosshair sports a 16-inch IPS display with a sharp QHD resolution that's powered by an Nvidia RTX 5060 graphics card with 8GB of fast VRAM. Other specs include a 20-core Intel Core Ultra 7 255HX processor, 16GB of memory, and a 1TB SSD. Windows 11 operating system comes preinstalled. View Deal Vector 16 HX AI: was $1999 now $1599 Get a 16-inch gaming laptop with Intel Core Ultra 7 255HX, RTX 5070 Ti with 12GB of VRAM, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 512GB SSD. View Deal The hardware included inside the Gigabyte Gaming A16 Pro includes Nvidia's RTX 5080 laptop graphics card with 16GB of VRAM, an Intel Core 7 240H processor, 32GB of RAM, and a 1TB SSD. View Deal November 28, 2026 – 2:59 AM Good morning and welcome to Saturday, where we're still tracking all the very best gaming laptop deals at all your favorite retailers! November 28, 2026 – 3:00 AM Black Friday has actually been very generous to gaming laptops in terms of deals and discounts, despite the ongoing pricing pressures. Many of the best deals we've seen so far are still live, and we're also hopeful there will be more savings as the weekend continues. November 28, 2026 – 3:12 AM Starting with a $900 discount... We'll kick things off with this Alienware gaming laptop with an RTX 5050. Despite the big price rises we've seen over the last 18 months across the board, you can still pick up a current-gen budget-friendly laptop, especially during a sales event. For instance, there's this Alienware 16 Aurora laptop, down from $1,999 to $1,099 . To be fair, nobody is paying $1,999 for a laptop like this; $1,099 is much, much more sensible, and makes it an appealing option for buyers. This Alienware 16 Aurora gaming laptop is perfect for casual gamers. It ships with a 10-core Intel Core 7 240H CPU, Nvidia GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU, plus 16GB of DDR5 memory and a 512GB SSD offering Gen 4 speeds. View Deal This laptop is an ideal option for someone on a lighter budget. Specs wise, the Nvidia GeForce RTX 5050 is the core component, along with the 10-core Intel Core 7 240H. You're also getting 16GB of DDR5 RAM, along with 512GB of SSD storage with decent Gen 4 speeds. You're getting a 2,560 x 1,600 resolution on this 16-inch laptop: that's a nice surprise, especially as budget laptops like this would typically go lower. That's good for productivity, but for gaming, you're probably not going to be able to hit 1600p with the RTX 5050, so bear that in mind. That issue aside, this is a good quality, well built laptop from the premium Alienware brand. It's got white backlighting, so you can keep gaming in the dark, but it's not overly flashy with RGB, so ideal for day-to-day work, too. — Ben Stockton

title: Best Black Friday 2026 tech deals live
summary: All the best Black Friday deals for tech and PC hardware you can still buy this weekend.
content: Black Friday might technically be over, but the deals continue through the weekend! Nearly all of the best deals and savings we've covered so far are still live, so there is plenty of time to save money at Amazon, Newegg, Best Buy, Walmart, and more. We're tracking the best deals still live on PC gaming hardware across every category, including CPUs, GPUs, RAM, SSDs, gaming laptops, desktops, tools, and more. As always, we make recommendations based on our thousands of hours of hands-on testing, extensive benchmarking database, and price tracking tools to ensure deals are actually deals. With AI pushing up the price of PC gaming, finding a deal is more difficult, but more important than ever before, so let us do the hard work. Here are the best ongoing Black Friday weekend deals. November 28, 2026 – 2:16 AM Good morning and welcome to Saturday! The team are here to show you all the latest and greatest deals still available at your favorite retailers. November 28, 2026 – 2:17 AM Black Friday is really now an all-weekend, if not an all-November affair. As such, all the deals we brought you earlier this week and on Friday itself are generally still live. In fact, there are even some fresh deals we haven't seen before! November 28, 2026 – 2:35 AM Intel's Core Ultra 7 270K Plus hits $249.99, with a free 360mm AIO and two additional games Intel's Core Ultra 270K plus lives on our list of the best CPUs for gaming for a good reason; not only is it adept at crunching through the latest games, but it's also our top pick for anyone looking for a top-shelf productivity workhorse. Intel's latest and greatest CPU is listed at $269 at Newegg, but it also comes with a stackable code, knocking the price down to $249 with a handful of free gifts: A Rosewill 360mm AIO liquid cooler, in addition to an Intel Gaming Bundle where you can pick from two free titles, including Total War: Warhammer 40,000 , Star Wars: Galactic Racer , and more. Core Ultra 7 270K Plus: was $309.95 now $249.99 Get Intel's latest and greatest processor, the 270K Plus. The 8p/16e core processor has plenty of oomph to plow through any workflow and games well, too. View Deal Future Future Future The Intel Core Ultra 270K Plus manages to go toe-to-toe in gaming performance with AMD's Ryzen 7 7800X3D, and is one of the best CPUs available now in productivity workloads. Sporting a total of 24 cores, split into 8 P-Cores and 16 E-Cores, the configuration actually matches the same core config as the much pricier Core Ultra 9 285K. Boasting clock speeds of up to 5.5GHz, this is a seasonal offer you don't want to miss out on. — Sayem Ahmed November 28, 2026 – 2:50 AM Equip yourself with a monstrous 16TB HDD, priced at just 2 cents per-gigabyte Getting a good HDD deal in this market is a rare thing, and this deal we spotted yesterday over at Newegg for an external 16TB Seagate HDD works out to just two cents per gigabyte. Yes, it uses a USB 3.0 interface, but for cold storage of larger files, images, or video, you don't really need blisteringly fast transfer speeds in the first place. Coming in at $399.99, Seagate's External HDD might be the answer to all of your storage woes, or just offer you necessary extra room. Expansion Desktop 16TB External Hard Drive: was $549.99 now $399.99 The Seagate Expansion Desktop drive is a 16TB HDD that connects via USB 3.0. It's formatted to ExFAT by default, allowing it to work with virtually any platform, straight out of the box. The device is powered by an included AC power cable, and connects to your system over a Micro-B to USB-A connector. View Deal The Seagate 16TB drive inside is usually easily shuckable, though do take care in doing so if that's your intention: Usually we'll see a white-labelled drive, and it's easy to accidentally damage the HDD while doing so. However, if you're brave enough to void your warranty, it could be a worthwhile endeavor. Getting a 16TB HDD anywhere else will cost much more, so if you're up for a bit of risk-reward, it could make for a solid extra internal drive, or suitable for use in a NAS. The Micro-B to USB-A connector is a touch outdated in 2026, but if it's still going to be fast enough for transferring files. If you shuck the drive itself, expect standard SATA power and data connectors instead. It's difficult to argue with the price-per-gigabyte on this deal, so if you're looking to upgrade your storage this holiday, don't sleep on this Newegg deal. — Sayem Ahmed November 28, 2026 – 3:06 AM This is the cheapest 2TB PCIe 5.0 NVMe SSD we've seen so far: pay 18 cents per gigabyte for ultra-fast storage SanDisk’s 2TB Optimus GX Pro 8100 PCIe 5.0 SSD got a $95 discount and hit an all-time low of $349 over at Amazon. The drive itself boasts up to 14,900 MB/s read speeds and 14,000 MB/s write speeds, almost completely saturating the bandwidth available on its Silicon Motion SM2508 PCIe 5.0 x4 controller. The Optimus GX Pro 8100 uses Kioxia's BiCS8 218-layer TLC 3D CBA NAND, paired with 2GB of DDR4-3200 memory for use as a cache for fast, bursty work. Optimus GX Pro 8100 2TB: was $444.43 now $349.99 All-time low price. Expand your internal storage with SanDisk's 2TB Optimus GX Pro 8100 PCIe 5.0 NVMe SSD. This speedy drive offers 14,900/14,000 r/w speeds and has a 5-year warranty. View Deal (Image credit: Future) The overall price of the SanDisk Optimus GX Pro 8100 means that you'll be grabbing this incredibly fast storage at a mere 18 cents per gigabyte, which is stellar value for a PCIe 5.0 drive such as this, and it's one of the lowest prices we've seen a 2TB PCIe 5.0 drive drop to this Black Friday weekend. When we benchmarked the 8TB version of this SSD, we found that under certain conditions, it managed to beat out Samsung's 9100 Pro. In addition to being super quick and cheaper than its closest rivals, you can also expect to get a five-year limited warranty in case things go awry. – Sayem Ahmed

title: Best Black Friday Gaming PC Deals live
summary: All the best Black Friday gaming PC deals you can still buy this weekend.
content: Black Friday might technically be over, but all the best gaming PC deals we've seen are still very much live. Right now, with AI driving up component prices, buying a gaming PC is one of the easiest ways to offset the very worst price hikes on SSDs, RAM, and GPUs, with buying a pre-built PC often cheaper than DIY in late 2026. A quick look at part prices will tell you this. The RTX 5080 GPU now costs around $2,000, while the RTX 5090 has all but disappeared from the consumer market. 32GB of DDR5-6000 RAM now costs $500, while a 1TB SSD is $250. Black Friday has given us some deals on these prices, but buying a gaming PC is still more economical in many cases. We're tracking the best configurations and rigs at Amazon, Newegg, Best Buy, and Walmart, as well as offerings from vendors like HP, MSI, Dell, and more. We use our hands-on testing experience, extensive benchmark data, and price tracking to find you real deals. View Deal November 28, 2026 – 2:36 AM Welcome to Saturday and our ongoing coverage of the best gaming PC deals on Black Friday. While some of our top deals have expired, many more remain available, and we expect new offerings to emerge over the weekend. November 28, 2026 – 2:39 AM The biggest draw to buying a pre-built gaming PC in 2026, aside from the usual benefits of convenience and dealing with just one vendor for shipping and warranties, etc., is price. Most Nvidia RTX GPUs are between 60-200% more expensive than their MSRP. Likewise, RAM and SSD prices are through the roof, making building your own rig a daunting task. The team is here to help you find pre-built alternatives. November 28, 2026 – 3:05 AM This Thermaltake PC gets you Core Ultra 5 250KF Plus and 5060 Ti power at a friendly price Entry-level prebuilt PC spec lists can be a real luck-of-the-draw affair on the CPU side. Sometimes you have to take an older chip in exchange for a better GPU, memory, or SSD spec at a given price. But Thermaltake's LCGS NE u2560T-V170B prebuilt is thoroughly modern from top to bottom. It pairs Intel's latest Core Ultra 5 250KF Plus with an RTX 5060 Ti 8GB graphics card for just $1399 at Newegg this Black Friday weekend . Get a thoroughly modern budget gaming PC with Thermaltake's LCGS NE u2560T-V170B. This system pairs the latest Intel Core Ultra 5 250KF Plus with the RTX 5060 Ti 8GB for an awesome 1080p gaming experience. View Deal The RTX 5060 Ti 8GB gives you great 1080p gaming performance for around the same system cost as many RTX 5060 prebuilts right now. In our 2026 GPU Hierarchy testing , this chip delivered a geomean of 100.4 FPS in raster titles at 1080p, so it'll offer a great high-refresh-rate gaming experience in this system. GPU Benchmarks — 1080p Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future Future The Core Ultra 5 250KF serves up a whopping 18 CPU cores (6P + 12E) of Arrow Lake Refresh power with peak clocks of up to 5.3 GHz on the P cores. We called it "the best new $200 CPU" in our review , and it's an awesome foundation for this system. Along with those parts, you get 16GB of DDR5-6000 RAM and a 1TB SSD for a solid starting point to your 1080p gaming adventures. And at least in raster titles, the power of the RTX 5060 Ti plus the performance boost offered by DLSS 4.5 upscaling means you might even be able to explore 1440p gaming, too. Get this power-packed system for less as we roll into the Black Friday weekend. -- Jeff Kampman
